summary: Innovative Industrial Properties filed an 8-K reporting entry into an ATM Advance Agreement with A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners for a $20 million term loan due October 9, 2026, bearing 10.0% interest compounding monthly. The loan is secured by gross proceeds from the company's at-the-market equity offering program under a separate Sales Agreement. The loan carries mandatory prepayment triggers and a 1% setup fee, with proceeds intended for general corporate purposes including repaying existing senior notes. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special-situation event.
